dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent elliptical 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible in the central-lateral field. These features exhibit light-intensity perimeters with a soft-edge gradient transitioning into lower-intensity interior cores. The geometric perimeters vary from closed circular loops to semi-closed arcs with irregular pixel widths.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High-intensity pixel clusters are primarily localized to the thin perimeters of the ring structures rather than forming solid blobs. There is a higher density of solid low-intensity pixel clusters in the anterior region, which lack internal gradients or defined boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most distinct central macro-annuli form an irregular quadrilateral. Connecting the three most prominent central rings creates an obtuse triangle with the longest side oriented along the longitudinal axis of the subject.
